notes.title: Devblog 1
notes.content:
Hello everyone, I'm super grateful for all the wishlists the game has received! 

My name is Viktor and I am the sole developer on this game. Progress has been slow but steady as I work on this game in my spare time and also have school and other stuff to deal with. But there has still been progress and I want to share some of it in this post. 

My current plan is that the game will be divided into different sections (levels). In these, you will face different threats and puzzles that will help you progress. I am currently trying to finalize the story of the game so I can finish the first section.
 
Here are some Images of new models I've made for the game:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40710242/97973cd1e71a0b40e05541c7c5d5f8668bd8aa1c.png[/img]

[img]https://images-ext-2.discordapp.net/external/WTCRP_kqUyzobl_rbwyBF-nm-gxhWFVMGpfYI42FQ88/https/i.gyazo.com/515dc914960421b34acc1bae49caec66.gif?width=900&height=562[/img]


I've also done a lot of coding to create better interaction systems, puzzles, and more general stuff. I don't want to share too many details as I don't want to spoil story stuff and things might change. But I hope this gave you some more insight into who I am and how the development is going. I don't have a schedule for when I will make a second devblog but it will most likely be once the first section is done.

Feel free to check out the discord where I post progress images and have more information. 
Discord:
https://discord.gg/xWAzUVDgdf

-Viktor
